name: October close records.eml
subject: HANGS Construction Services October 2026 close records
body:
Hello,

Attached are the October 2026 billing register, purchases register and general ledger export for HANGS Construction Services LLC. The job list, the reseller permits on file and the invoice for change order 7 on Pier 9 Tech Center are in the shared folder.

Please note the October trial balance has not been approved yet. Treat the ledger as unapproved until I confirm.

The only reseller permit we hold for October subcontract work is Cedar Ridge Builders. We have asked Summit Line Construction for theirs.

Please prepare the October combined excise return as a draft for review. We file it ourselves in My DOR once it is reviewed.

Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS Construction Services
